༄༅/ /sde 'dun gyi dbang chog lag len dang bcas pa bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sde 'dun gyi dbang chog lag len dang bcas pa bzhugs so/ /

bla ma dang yi dam lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir dam can sde bdun gyi rjes su gnang ba byed par 'dod pas/ maṇ+ḍal dpe'u chung ltar bris la/ gtor ma dang mchod pa sgrub thabs ltar bshams la/ so so'i sku gsung thugs kyi mtshan ma dgod/ gral ma nor bar bla ma dang sngags srung dbus/ shan pa shar/ gza' lho/ gnod/ nas kyis chos 'byung bsnol ma bri/ sbyin nub/ dam can byang*/ legs ldan lcam dral byang shar du bsham/ gzhan yang tshogs kyi mchod pa/ gtor ma/ spyan gzigs la sogs pa sgrub thabs ltar bsham/ rjes gnang gi thod pa/ bshos bu/ ri rab/ ba dan/ rgyal mtshan/ snying phreng*/ mchod gtor/ thun rdzas/ rak+ta/ yungs kar/ phur pa/ ral gri rnams tshogs par bya'o/ / dngos gzhi'i phrin las dngos grub 'byung gter ram/ dpag bsam ljon shing ltar rgyas par bya'o/ /de nas slob ma gcig las mang bar spel du mi rung bas/ khrus bya/ yon phul la thal mo sbyar te/ bla ma kun tu bzang po'am che mchog thod phreng rtsal gang yin du mos la/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ e ma slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ni bstan pa bsrung bya'i phyir/ /bde bar gshegs pas bka' bsgos pa/ /dregs pa mthu yi dbang bskur zhu/ /zhes lan gsum brjod la/ /slob dpon gyis/ tshur shog skal ldan rigs kyi bu/ /bstan pa bsrung bar dgongs pa legs/ /drag sngags mthu yi dbang bskur gyis/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa thub par srungs/ /zhes pas lce la dam chu bzhag la/ /'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub thob/ /ces pas byin no/ /de nas dbang bskur ba ni/ gtor ma rnams rang rang gi gzhal yas khang du mos pa'i nang du rang rang gi sku gzhung ltar bskyed la brda sprad la/ /slob ma kun bzang che mchog gang rung du bsgom du bcug ste/ gtor ma spyi bor bzhag la/ / hūm̐/ dpal ldan gtso mo e kadza ṭī ma/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis ru lu'i sgra skad sgrogs/

/kun tu bzang mo dbyings kyi ma mo mchog /las dang ye shes tshogs kyi rje mo che/ /skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas/ / sngags srung 'grub phyed mthu dbang thob pa dang*/ /phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub par shog /oṃ ma ma e ka dza ṭī trag rak+ṣa snying kha rag+mo ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐/ kā ya ba liṃ taṃ a bhi ṣiñca oṃ/ wā kra ba liṃ ta a bhi ṣiñca āḥ tsit+ta ba liṃ ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ gnas gsum du gtugs/ sngags srung gi sku gsung thugs dang slob ma'i lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med du gyur nas ma mo'i mthu dbang thob ste bsgo ba nyan cing lus dang grib ltar 'grogs par bsam mo/ / sngags kyi rjes gnang ni/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas sngags phreng byung ba slob ma'i zhal du zhugs/ lus kyi dbyibs brgyud gsang gnas nas thon/ sngags srung gi mkhar zhugs zhal nas thon/ slob dpon gyi gsang gnas nas zhugs/ 'gal me'i 'khor lo ltar 'khor bas ma mo'i sngags kyi dngos grub thob nas las byed par bsam la/ snying po ci nus bgrangs la/ slob mas/ sngags srung bdag la stsal lags kyis/ /bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum brjod/ bla mas/ sngags srung 'di la stsal lags kyis/ /'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /gsum brjod/ me tog dor/ thugs kyi rjes gnang ni/ mdun gyi ma mo slob ma la bstim/ slob ma yang 'od du zhu ba las 'ja' yal ba ltar gyur nas dbyer med pa'i don la bzhag go /'di ni gnad gal po che srung ma dang dbyer med bsres pa'i 'khu ldog mi 'byung zhing snying nye ba'i dgos pa'o/ /de 'og ma kun la 'gres shes par bya'o/ /rang rang gi gtor ma dang sku gzugs spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas gsum du bzhag cing*/ dmigs pa rnams go brje zhing*/ hūm̐/ dpal ldan mgon po mahā kā la ya/ /bstod pa ltar bya zhing*/ khyad par du rje mo 'khor bcas zhes pa'i gnas su/

/ma hā kā la 'khor dang bcas pa yis/ /skal ldan rigs kyi bu la sogs gong ltar ro/ /oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ye shā sa na kā ya ba lid+ta a bhi ṣiñca oṃ/ wākra tsit+ta sogs dang*/ sngags kyi rjes gnang dang*/ thugs kyi rjes gnang gong ltar ro/ /re ma ti'i gtor ma bzhag la/ bstan pa bsrung mdzad 'khor dang bcas pa yis sogs/ oṃ trag rak+ṣa re ma ti kā ya ba lid+ta a bhi ṣiñca oṃ/ wākra tsit+ta sogs/ srog sgrub kyi gtor ma bzhag la/ nam gru nag mo 'jigs pa'i tshogs bcas kyis/ /sogs/ oṃ khyi kha len nag mo sod/ srog ma ti sod/ snying kha kha bam ya ma sod/ tsa bam bi ri mu sod/ gha ya sod/ nri ya sod/ rak+ṣo ṇi ra rbud/ kā ya ba liṃ ta a bhi ṣiñca oṃ/ wākra tsit+ta sogs gza'i gtor ma bzhag la/ sring bzhi sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa yis/ /skal ldan =sogs/ hrī shag ru raṃ nā ge tsit+ta traṃ ma ma yo za 'gram ha he yo gi shā la dza dzaḥ kā ya ba li dha a bhi ṣiñca oṃ/ wāk tsit+ta sogs/ dmar nag gi gtor ma bzhag la/ drag gtum chen mo 'khor dang bcas pa yis/ /skal ldan sogs/ oṃ e h+ye hi rma ru tse gu ṇa dhi tri gh+raṃ bh+yo/ sha raṃ bh+yo pu ra dza dh+ri k/ hral gh+ran tsaya dzaḥdzaḥ kā ya ba liṃ ta a bhi ṣiñca oṃ/ wāk tsit+ta sogs/ dam can gyi gtor ma bzhag la/ 'khor dang bcas pa ma lus thams cad kyis/ skal ldan= oṃ badz+ra sā dhu sa ma ya has byas ha bya gle gad sha/ e bha sha ya dza dzaḥ kā ya ba liṃ ta/ wāk tsit+ta sogs/ thod pa spyi bor bzhag la/ hūm̐/ yang dag gsang ba'i thod pa 'dis/ /sde brgyad rnams kyi pho brang gnas na rten/ bhan+dha rdzas mchog 'di yis dbang bskur bas/ /sde brgyad ma lus las la 'gyed par shog /ka pā la a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ bshos bus dbang bskur ba/ hūm̐/ bshos bu bzhi brtsegs mar me lnga dang ldan/ khams gsum srid pa gsum dang yang dag ldan/ /bshos bu ri rab lhun pos dbang bskur bas/

/dam can srung ma ma lus mnyes byed shog /oṃ ba liṃ ta sogs dang*/ /rten gyi ri rab kyi dbang*/ hūṃ/ gling chen bzhi dang ri rab bcas pa yi/ /sku rten dam pa 'di yis dbang bskur bas/ /dam can srung ma ma lus 'khor bcas rnams/ /dbang du bsdu shing 'khor ba'i dbang thob shog /oṃ rat+na maṇ+ḍal a/ /ba dan gtad la/ dar gyi ba dan sna tshogs sku yi rgyan/ /dar lce g.yer kha mang pos spud cing gsil/ /mdzes pa'i rgyan cha 'di yis dbang bskur bas/ /yang dag phun tshogs rgyan dang ldan par shog /pa tra dam ma/ rgyal mtshan gtad la/ sna tshogs rgyan gyis mdzes pa'i rgyal mtshan 'di/ /mnga' thang longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa yi/ /yid 'ong rgyal mtshan mchog gis dbang bskur bas/ /'dod rgu'i bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub par shog /dhā dza gwa a/ snying phreng gtad la/ hūm̐/ rang rang mthun pa'i dam tshig rdzas kyi mchog /sems can sna tshogs bsgral ba'i snying phreng 'dis/ /skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas/ /mi 'bral lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs par shog /tsit+ta a/ mchod gtor gtad la/ drag po'i mchod gtor rdzas mchog dam pa 'dis/ /skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas/ /bka' srung dam can sde brgyad ma lus pa/ /thams cad bu la 'du ba'i dbang thob shog /ma hā ba liṃ ta sogs/ /thun rdzas gtad la/ /gdug pa'i rdzas rgod sna tshogs sbyar ba yi/ /mngags pa'i pho nya gdug pa'i mtshon dbal 'dis/ / skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas/ /sna tshogs drag po'i las rnams 'grub par shog /oṃ dug thun a= /rak+ta gtad la/ hūṃ/ bdag 'dzin chags pa bral ba'i rak+ta 'di/ /dgra bgegs gsod pa'i mtshon cha ma mo'i nad/ /skal ldan= /drag sngags dmod pa'i las rnams 'grub par shog /oṃ ma hā rak+ta/ yungs kar gtad la/ yungs kar rgyal po drang srong dmod pa'i mda'/ /mngags pa'i pho nya gsod pa'i dam rdzas mchog /sna tshogs mtshon dang gdug pa'i dpal yin pas/

/phrin las rnam bzhi ma lus 'grub par shog /phur pa'i dbang bskur ba/ hūṃ/ brnag pa mthar phyin drag po'i phur ba 'di/ /mngags pa'i pho nya mtshon cha'i dbal rnon 'dis/ /skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas/ /dgra bgegs gdug pa ma lus sgrol bar shog /oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya a= ral gri gtad la/ hūm̐/ 'khor ba'i skye shi rtsad nas gcod pa yi/ /gdug pa'i mtshon cha rab tu 'bar ba 'dis/ /skal ldan rigs kyi bu+u la dbang bskur bas/ /dgra bgegs srog rtsa ma lus gcod par shog /oṃ khaḍ+ga a zhes brjod la gtor ma gtsang sar gshegs// gzhung gi bya ba rnams sgrub thabs ltar bya'o/ /gtor ma'i dbang gi rjes su/ smon lam ni/ sngags srung smug nag khros ma'i rgyal mo 'khor dang bcas pas/ skal ldan rdo rje slob ma che ge mo 'di la sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi sgo nas dbang dang dngos grub stsol ba dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung ba la nus mthu dang ldan par mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa dang*/ thugs kyi rjes gnang gi mjug tu/ rang rang gi snying po'i gsham du/ tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra hūm̐/ zhes pas rdo rje snying gar gtug go /de bzhin du legs ldan nag po 'khor dang bcas pas/ shan pa srog sgrub 'khor dang bcas pas/ gza' mchog chen po 'khor dang bcas pas/ shan pa dmar nag 'khor dang bcas pas/ dam can rdo rje legs pa 'khor dang bcas pas/ zhes sogs bla ma'i zhal las byung ba ltar klong chen rab 'byams kyis phyi rabs kyi don du bkod pa'o/ /'di'i bcas shoms la/ nas kyi chos 'byung bsnol ma/ bla ma dang e ka dza ṭī dbus/ legs ldan rnams la pad 'dab bzhi bzhi/ gza' dang gnod sbyin la e ka dza ṭi dang 'dra ba la rgyab tu sman leb/ tel ba/ snod gru bzhi mkhar la ba gam med par mgo /thams cad la pad+ma 'dab bzhi ma/ las gtor lha mo dang 'dra ba gcig lho nub tu bzhag /gru gsum lnga brtsegs la ma me lnga bzhag

/dam rdzas thod chang*/ rak+ta/ rgyal mtshan/ 'phan/ snying phreng*/ rten rdzas ral gri/ yungs kar gang bzang*/ mda' dar rnams so/ / rjes gnang ni/ slob dpon dang slob ma tsho lhar bskyed/ mdun bskyed tsho bskyed la/ rang rang lus nam mkhar yal ba ltar ngang la 'jog pa sku'i rjes gnang*/ gsung sngags phreng 'khor ma rbad bcad dang bgrang du 'jug pa slob ma la thim du bcug /e ka dza ṭī nas bzung ste so sor/ 'di la stsal lags kyi/ /sogs rjes gnang rdzogs rting*/ de nas gtor stegs 'og tu lag gnyis bcug la mgo thog tu dmigs pa byed/ bla ma brgyud pa snying tig bzhin/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gi phrin las bcol ba'i bka' bsgos rjes de nas gsol gdab bya'o/ /sde bdun gyi bcas shoms lag khrid du bkod pa rdzogs so// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (25) sde 'dun gyi dbang chog lag len dang bcas pa/ - PAGE 208 -- PAGE 207 -- PAGE 202 -
